buildCommand: DART_DEFINES=''; if [ -n "$FIREBASE_API_KEY" ]; then DART_DEFINES="--dart-define=FIREBASE_API_KEY=$FIREBASE_API_KEY --dart-define=FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=$FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN --dart-define=FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=$FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID --dart-define=FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID=$FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID --dart-define=FIREBASE_APP_ID=$FIREBASE_APP_ID"; fi; if [ "$FLUTTER_DEMO_MODE" = "true" ]; then DART_DEFINES="$DART_DEFINES --dart-define=FLUTTER_DEMO_MODE=true"; fi; flutter/bin/flutter build web --release --pwa-strategy=none $DART_DEFINES
installCommand: npm install && git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git --depth 1 -b stable && flutter/bin/flutter doctor && flutter/bin/flutter pub get
